title: The protective effects of phenolic-rich breadfruit (Artocarpus altilis) ethanol extract against trichloroethylene-induced nephrotoxicity: In vivo and in silico studies.
authors: Dahunsi, Damilola Timothy; Lawal, Akeem Olalekan; Akinjiyan, Moses Orimoloye; Agboola, Olaoluwa Oladimeji; Ijatuyi, Taiwo Tolulope; Ademosun, Ayokunle Olubode; Remilekun, Akinrinmade
one_liner_zh: 该研究为面包果提取物对三氯乙烯肾毒性的保护作用，涉及小分子与蛋白的分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Breadfruit (Artocarpus altilis) has been traditionally used as a nephroprotective agent, but limited information exists on its underlying molecular mechanisms. Trichloroethylene (TCEL) is a toxicant that negatively impacts the kidneys. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study investigated breadfruit leaf ethanol extract's (BF) ability to protect against TCEL-induced nephrotoxicity. Thirty Wistar rats were divided into six groups (n = 5) and treated orally for 15 days. Group I received corn oil; group II (TCEL 1000 mg/kg); groups III and IV received BF at 100 and 200 mg/kg, respectively. Groups V and VI were administered 100 and 200 mg/kg of BF, respectively, 2 h before TCEL exposure. Serum urea, albumin, uric acid, creatinine, and bilirubin were evaluated using standard protocols after sacrifice. KIM-1, SOD, CAT, JNK, p38 MAPK, and p53 genes' expression studies were done with RT-PCR. Molecular docking and free binding energy of BF compounds with NF-kappaB, p38 MAPK, and p53 were performed using the Schrodinger suite. RESULTS: TCEL (1000 mg/kg) significantly (p < 0.05) elevated urea, albumin, uric acid, creatinine, and bilirubin serum levels and upregulated KIM-1 and JNK gene expression compared to control. Pre-treatment of rats with BF (100 and 200 mg/kg) significantly increased SOD and CAT gene expressions, reduced serum levels of kidney biomarkers, and modulated p38 MAPK and p53 gene expressions compared with TCEL-induced untreated groups. The free binding energies and molecular docking of A. altilis compounds with NF-kappaB, p38 MAPK, and p53 suggest possible interactions. CONCLUSION: The study suggests that BF could be an effective agent against TCEL-induced toxicity.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：面包果（Artocarpus altilis）传统上被用作肾脏保护剂，但其潜在的分子机制信息有限。三氯乙烯（TCEL）是一种对肾脏产生负面影响的毒物。研究目的：本研究探讨了面包果叶乙醇提取物（BF）对TCEL诱导的肾毒性的保护能力。三十只Wistar大鼠被分为六组（n = 5），并口服处理15天。第I组接受玉米油；第II组（TCEL 1000 mg/kg）；第III组和第IV组分别接受100和200 mg/kg的BF。第V组和第VI组在TCEL暴露前2小时分别给予100和200 mg/kg的BF。处死后，使用标准方案评估血清尿素、白蛋白、尿酸、肌酐和胆红素。通过RT-PCR进行KIM-1、SOD、CAT、JNK、p38 MAPK和p53基因的表达研究。使用Schrodinger套件对BF化合物与NF-kappaB、p38 MAPK和p53进行分子对接和自由结合能计算。结果：与对照组相比，TCEL（1000 mg/kg）显著（p < 0.05）升高了血清尿素、白蛋白、尿酸、肌酐和胆红素水平，并上调了KIM-1和JNK基因表达。与TCEL诱导的未处理组相比，用BF（100和200 mg/kg）预处理大鼠显著增加了SOD和CAT基因表达，降低了肾脏生物标志物的血清水平，并调节了p38 MAPK和p53基因表达。A. altilis化合物与NF-kappaB、p38 MAPK和p53的自由结合能和分子对接表明可能存在相互作用。结论：研究表明，BF可能是对抗TCEL诱导毒性的有效药剂。
